full_semantic_decision_read.full_chain_observation: 同一完整native LivingHurt onEntityHurt最后：目标ServerPlayer且directSource为Living且Curios装备Cube→当前amount<=getDamageLimit(cursed150else100)并随机<=.35→cancel、directLiving.hurt沿用原DamageSource/currentAmount、再目标坐标play SWORD_HIT_REJECT；否则Cube.applyRandomEffect(directLiving,false)从实际debuff list选随机duration/amp addEffect。
full_semantic_decision_read.concrete_observation: 一个低于阈值概率拒伤+无条件报声/反伤的最终点1。与既有Cube LOW endEntityHurt的超阈整次拒绝是两个不同native listener和可触发负例，不能仅按同物品合并所有语义，也不因9个debuff或两阈值拆。超过阈值或随机失败仅对directLiving加随机debuff，本阶段不cancel，不能全算免疫。拒伤后不论攻击者hurt返回真假仍响拒绝声；source归属不重写，若native攻击者也是source.entity，则是以原归属向自己伤害，而非确认源已反转。无每目标/每攻击者节流、有限资源或事件序号，同次递归若满足其余条件仍需动态看pipeline。负面addEffect未检查接纳，不能以声/状态最终为空判断反伤或拒控成功。
full_semantic_decision_read.application_to_boss_immune: 为Boss文字/嗡声设置明确拒控reason与一次回执；反伤结果、加debuff失败和声音生产独立，不能从任何一个反推其余已通过。保持普通阴阳体质type9边界。
full_semantic_decision_read.limitations: 固定源码，完整native方法及随机选择/helper/构造debuff表/音注册已读；没有读音频资源或实机听音，不将原版SoundEvent提交当实际S2C感官通过。native阈值事件优先级组合与并发不静态宣称已验。未改正式Java/资产/任务。

full_chain.stage: actual stack qualification and attack cancellation
full_chain.observation: NORMAL LivingAttack subscriber first checks target world server and source.getEntity instanceof LivingEntity. Uses that source actor CURRENT MAINHAND, not source.directEntity or a captured attack/projectile stack. EnchantmentHelpers loops raw getEnchantmentTags, compares registry key to each id ResourceLocation and returns first index; no lvl>0 test. If matchingid and unuseTooltrue, setCanceled(true) andreturn. It doesnot stopUsingItem (commented out). No positive damage/source-type/player/creative/target-immunity gate shown; not all entities but any qualifying Living source actor. No explicit alreadycanceled check; Forge dispatch of previously canceled events not expanded.

unuseTool computes damageBorder=getMaxDamage()-5. If current getDamageValue>=border, first calls setDamageValue(border), then returns true causing actual cancel. This may request reducing damage from an overshot value to boundary, not simply prevent additional wear; later attempts at exactly boundary refuse again. If below boundary returnsfalse without modifying. No separate lock flag, elapsed timer, stored target, damage acknowledgement or retry counter. It does not check isDamageableItem in the runtime helper, so canEnchant does not prove malformed/enchant-injected stacks are excluded; lowmax negative parameter native normalization unverified.

NORMAL BlockEvent.BreakEvent gets player.getUsedItemHand before null-player check. If handnonnull, looks at that hand stack and same raw enchantid predicate, then unuseTool. On true cancels and calls releaseUsingItem. It doesnot explicitly side-check here or use original digging tool/mainhand unconditionally. Both event overloads share one policy; no perhand/method extra credit. The checked nullplayer condition cannot protect earlier dereferences; only conditional code observation, no engine-null event reproduction.

Existing EvilCraft constructor installs BloodChestRepairActionRegistry; complete registry constructor registers DamageableItemRepairAction first and dispatches selected action. Blood chest/blockentity configs and actual BlockBloodChest.getTicker choose server BlockEntityTickingTankInventory.TickerServer. BlockEntityTickerDelayed.tick invokes update before optional update publication backoff. Server update reads each actual slot and, unless redstone disables ticker, passes current stack to TickComponent. Component chooses Item.class action, canTick, increments progress and invokes onTick; empty/failed qualification resets progress by configured flag. Redstone skips component call, thus doesnot itself reset progress.

full_chain.stage: repair commits changed stack for later reentry
full_chain.observation: RepairItemTickAction canTick requires nonempty tank/item plus actions.canRepair. At required ticks, copies stack, reselects action, simulates cost then if fluid amount sufficient invokes repair doAction=true. Damageable action requires isDamaged, requests setDamageValue(current-1), may add random bad enchant, returnsmultiplier1 with stack. Caller then requests tank drain and writes resulting stack to actual slot via inventory.setItem; SimpleInventory stores it in contents then inventory-change callback. No atomic debit guarantee; native drain internals and callback consumers unexpanded. Concrete conditional recovery: if a normal max100 stack at damage95 is repaired successfully to94 and later used in checked hand, unuseTool sees94<95 and doesnot cancel. No timer/reset packet; every action reads current damage. Native inventory transfer, ItemStack normalization and engine successful action remain outside proof.

Refusal ceases when current selected stack lacks matching enchantid or current damage is below border; no retained peractor denial state to clear. Switching source mainhand also changes future attribution, including possible projectile-owned events; no originalweapon identity preserved. Source has no dedicated message/sound/particle/criterion or refusal packet. Mining releaseUsingItem is the only explicit use-state stop; native client correction/inventory synchronization not inspected. Blood chest open/close sound relates to openers, not repair success or immunity. No independent durable recovery receipt is claimed.
